key: # 规则相关的文字：法术、武器、状态、日志格式。日志格式里的 %s %d 是参数，顺序不能变。

zh_CN: 向目标射出一团火焰。1d10 火焰伤害。
en: Hurl a mote of fire. 1d10 fire damage.

zh_CN: 1d8 冷冻伤害，目标速度降低 3 米直到你的下个回合。
en: 1d8 cold damage and the target's speed drops by 3 m until your next turn.

zh_CN: 1d8 闪电伤害，目标无法使用反应。对穿金属甲的目标有优势。
en: 1d8 lightning damage; the target can't take reactions. Advantage against metal armour.

zh_CN: 感知豁免。失败受到 1d4 心灵伤害，下一次攻击有劣势。
en: Wisdom save. On a failure: 1d4 psychic damage and disadvantage on its next attack.

zh_CN: 三枚飞弹必定命中，每枚 1d4+1 力场伤害。
en: Three darts that always hit, 1d4+1 force damage each.

zh_CN: 反应：被击中时 AC +5，直到你的下个回合。
en: Reaction: +5 AC when hit, until your next turn.

zh_CN: 4.5 米锥形，敏捷豁免，3d6 火焰伤害，成功减半。
en: 4.5 m cone. Dexterity save, 3d6 fire damage, half on success.

zh_CN: 附赠动作。治疗 1d4 + 施法属性调整值。
触碰。治疗 1d8 + 施法属性调整值。
感知豁免，3d6 心灵伤害，成功减半。
en: Wisdom save, 3d6 psychic damage, half on success.

zh_CN: 身边 4.5 米，体质豁免，2d8 雷鸣伤害并击退 3 米，成功减半且不击退。
en: 4.5 m around you. Constitution save, 2d8 thunder damage and pushed 3 m; half and no push on success.

zh_CN: 专注。最多三名队友的攻击检定和豁免加 1d4。
en: Concentration. Up to three allies add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

zh_CN: 专注，附赠动作。目标 AC +2。
en: Concentration, bonus action. Target gains +2 AC.

zh_CN: 专注，附赠动作。你每次命中目标额外造成 1d6 黯蚀伤害。
en: Concentration, bonus action. Your hits on the target deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage.

zh_CN: 反应：受到伤害后，攻击者进行敏捷豁免，2d10 火焰伤害，成功减半。
en: Reaction when damaged: the attacker makes a Dexterity save, 2d10 fire damage, half on success.

zh_CN: 3 米半径，体质豁免，3d8 雷鸣伤害，成功减半。
en: 3 m radius. Constitution save, 3d8 thunder damage, half on success.

zh_CN: 6 米半径，敏捷豁免，8d6 火焰伤害，成功减半。
en: 6 m radius. Dexterity save, 8d6 fire damage, half on success.

zh_CN: 用远程武器攻击。超出常规射程有劣势，身边有敌人也有劣势。
en: Attack with your ranged weapon. Disadvantage beyond normal range or with an enemy next to you.

zh_CN: 附赠动作。用副手轻型武器攻击，伤害不加属性调整值。
en: Bonus action. Attack with your light off-hand weapon, no ability modifier to damage.

zh_CN: 近战攻击。命中时消耗一个法术位，额外 2d8 光耀伤害（每高一环 +1d8，对亡灵 +1d8）。未命中不消耗。
en: Melee attack. On a hit, spend a spell slot for an extra 2d8 radiant damage (+1d8 per slot level above 1st, +1d8 against undead). No slot spent on a miss.

zh_CN: 附赠动作。恢复 1d10 + 战士等级的生命值。短休恢复。
en: Bonus action. Regain 1d10 + fighter level hit points. Recharges on a short rest.

zh_CN: 获得一个额外动作。短休恢复。
en: Gain an additional action. Recharges on a short rest.

zh_CN: 触碰。从治疗池中恢复目标的生命值。
en: Touch. Restore hit points from your healing pool.

zh_CN: 附赠动作。队友下一次攻击检定或豁免加 1d6。
en: Bonus action. An ally adds 1d6 to their next attack roll or saving throw.

zh_CN: 附赠动作。本回合移动距离翻倍。
en: Bonus action. Double your movement this turn.

zh_CN: 附赠动作。本回合移动不会引发借机攻击。
en: Bonus action. Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks this turn.

zh_CN: 本回合移动不会引发借机攻击。
en: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks this turn.

zh_CN: 直到你的下个回合，对你的攻击有劣势，敏捷豁免有优势。
en: Until your next turn, attacks against you have disadvantage and you have advantage on Dexterity saves.

zh_CN: 扶起一名倒地的队友，恢复 1 点生命值。
en: Help a downed ally up with 1 hit point.

zh_CN: 战斗回到开始时的状态。
en: Combat returns to how it was when it began.
Ranged attack against a prone target

zh_CN: %s 进行死亡豁免：%d（成功 %d / 失败 %d）
en: %s makes a death saving throw: %d (successes %d / failures %d)
%s rolls a natural 20 and gets up

zh_CN: %s 语出惊人，%s 的攻击骰 -%d
敏捷豁免，失败受到 1d6 强酸伤害。
en: Dexterity save or take 1d6 acid damage.

zh_CN: 3 米内，体质豁免，失败受到 1d12 毒素伤害。
en: Within 3 m. Constitution save or take 1d12 poison damage.

zh_CN: 专注。你的下一次攻击有优势。
en: Concentration. Your next attack has advantage.

zh_CN: 未着甲的目标 AC 变为 13 + 敏捷调整值。
en: An unarmoured target's AC becomes 13 + Dexterity modifier.

zh_CN: 专注。3 米半径，敏捷豁免，失败的目标被照亮，对其攻击有优势。
en: Concentration. 3 m radius; creatures that fail a Dexterity save are outlined and attacks against them have advantage.

zh_CN: 专注，附赠动作。你的武器攻击额外造成 1d4 光耀伤害。
en: Concentration, bonus action. Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage.

zh_CN: 获得 5 点临时生命值（每高一环 +5）。带着临时生命被近战击中时，攻击者受到等量冷冻伤害。
en: Gain 5 temporary hit points (+5 per slot level above 1st). While they last, melee attackers take that much cold damage.

zh_CN: 专注。人形生物进行感知豁免，失败则被麻痹，每回合重新豁免。
en: Concentration. A humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is paralysed, repeating the save each turn.

zh_CN: 感知附近的天界、邪魔与亡灵。
en: Sense celestials, fiends and undead nearby.

zh_CN: 治疗池 = 圣武士等级 × 5。
en: A healing pool equal to 5 × paladin level.

zh_CN: 近战命中时可消耗法术位造成额外光耀伤害。
en: Spend a spell slot on a melee hit for extra radiant damage.

zh_CN: 附赠动作恢复生命值，短休恢复。
en: Regain hit points as a bonus action; recharges on a short rest.

zh_CN: 获得一个额外动作，短休恢复。
en: Gain an extra action; recharges on a short rest.
Choose your path as a fighter.

zh_CN: 短休时恢复部分法术位。
en: Recover some spell slots on a short rest.

zh_CN: 附赠动作给队友 1d6 激励骰，次数 = 魅力调整值。
en: Give an ally a 1d6 inspiration die as a bonus action; uses = Charisma modifier.

zh_CN: 没有熟练的检定（包括先攻）加一半熟练加值。
en: Add half your proficiency bonus to checks you aren't proficient in, including initiative.

zh_CN: 短休时队友额外恢复生命值。
en: Allies regain extra hit points on a short rest.

zh_CN: 两项熟练技能的熟练加值翻倍。
en: Double your proficiency bonus for two proficient skills.

zh_CN: 每回合一次，有优势或目标身边有队友时，灵巧或远程武器额外造成伤害。
en: Once per turn, deal extra damage with a finesse or ranged weapon when you have advantage or an ally is next to the target.

zh_CN: 附赠动作疾走、撤离或躲藏。
en: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.
Strike a pact with an otherworldly being.
Pact spell slots that recharge on a short rest.
Your patron grants you a gift.

zh_CN: 单手持一把近战武器、另一只手不持武器时，伤害 +2。
en: +2 damage with a one-handed melee weapon and no other weapon.

zh_CN: 双手或可双手持用的武器，伤害骰掷出 1 或 2 时重掷。
en: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice with two-handed or versatile weapons.

zh_CN: 副手攻击的伤害加上属性调整值。
en: Add your ability modifier to off-hand attack damage.

zh_CN: 掷出 19 或 20 都算重击。
en: Score a critical hit on a 19 or 20.

zh_CN: 语出惊人：反应，用激励骰减少敌人的攻击骰。
en: Cutting Words: use a reaction and an inspiration die to reduce an enemy's attack roll.

zh_CN: 快手：灵巧动作也能使用物品。
en: Fast Hands: Cunning Action can also use an object.

zh_CN: 邪魔之赐：击倒敌人时获得临时生命值。
en: Dark One's Blessing: gain temporary hit points when you drop a foe.

zh_CN: 魔能爆的伤害加上魅力调整值。
en: Add your Charisma modifier to Eldritch Blast damage.

zh_CN: 魔能爆命中时把目标推开 3 米。
en: Eldritch Blast pushes the target 3 m on a hit.
Ability scores don't meet the multiclass requirement
